note: Sets 2 and 3 of the court coverage atlas, plus the list of reference-basis probes. Authored data rather than a table inside forensics/tools/court_coverage.py, because each row is an auditable claim and a change to one reads as a data diff. The generator validates every row: an indirect `entry` must be an implemented export that the named court directly courts, and a non-observable row must carry a reason and an authority citation. A court named in `reference_probes` contributes basis `referenced` rather than `called`, which the atlas states in its own `claim`. See docs/DECISIONS.md D199.
